errors.text_span: 这些扇区在视觉上并未严格按照大小比例递减或递增的顺序排列
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the slices of the main pie chart are not arranged in order of size. In fact, they are arranged in descending order of size, proceeding counter-clockwise starting from the largest slice: D (27.8%), B (25.3%), C (20.7%), E (10.1%), A (9%), and F (7.1%).
